rationale: Read complete fixture, hooks and actual task/coordinator-identity handlers. The test supplies separate identity/task responses, restores terminal environment and preserves the shell-stripped dependency string at the correct mutation boundary.

cases.title: passes PowerShell-stripped deps through to the runtime
cases.reason: Explicit PowerShell-stripped dependency text reaches taskCreate as-is after a live creator identity response; coordinator identity is carried and fallback terminal selection is forbidden. This is a CLI mapping control, not execution of PowerShell or server-side dependency parsing.

rationale: Read both cases and actual task-list/summary/output contracts. Name a Run to isolate brief preprocessing from caller identity RPCs; require one exact list RPC and one fresh JSON writer call. Replace unchecked casts and length-only output oracle; preserve server row values without imposing object identity. Final integration uses an actual RuntimeClient instance with a stubbed call method and complete checked handler context, removing unsafe context casts.

cases.title: requests server-side brief and falls back client-side for older runtimes
cases.reason: Use an actual RPC response envelope and a Run-scoped read, require exactly one taskList request and its current JSON output, and compare the independently stated normalized 160-character text plus truncation flag instead of length alone.

cases.title: passes server-abbreviated rows through untouched
cases.reason: Preserve the server-provided brief row and true truncation flag by comparing output values. Remove array-identity requirement; a semantically equivalent copy is valid, while incorrectly re-abbreviating the short server result flips its flag and fails.

rationale: Read complete launcher rows, direct console observations, exit-code/environment cleanup and actual question/compatibility handler. Preserve commit/resume distinction and both supported launcher names. No shell/native app executes.

cases.title: commits with the %s launcher and exits 75 before resume
cases.reason: Each packaged launcher name is propagated to the question RPC, printed in the committed-question resume command, and causes exit code 75 after the actual stdout flush.

parameter_inputs.reason: Primary packaged launcher must round-trip to RPC and resume output.
Linux-associated packaged executable spelling remains a valid Windows launcher alias and must round-trip exactly.

cases.title: resumes the committed question without another exit-75 handoff
cases.reason: Resuming a committed question sends resume without a new question, prints the returned answer and leaves exit code unset instead of another exit-75 handoff.
